releases.new: Pass signals or params directly into datum lookups, and use expression objects inside value(), instead of building expression strings by hand.
releases.breaking: Python 3.10 is no longer supported, so upgrade Python first. Invalid extra arguments to property setters now raise a TypeError instead of being silently ignored; remove them.

releases.new: Use the updated Olli v3 integration for accessible chart descriptions, and type-check Altair code with the ty checker.
Layer simple faceted charts that share the same facet variables, with facet encodings hoisted automatically, plus Vega-Lite 6.4.1 updates like newlines in tooltips.
releases.breaking: Python 3.9 support was dropped as part of the pandas 3 compatibility work, so upgrade to Python 3.10 or newer before installing.
